-- Helper: lower bound when both positive

lemma lower_bound_strict (p q : ℕ) (hp_pos : 0 < p) (hq_pos : 0 < q) :
  (p + q)^2 < p^2 + 7*p*q + q^2 := by nlinarith

-- Helper: upper bound when p ≤ q

lemma upper_bound_p_le_q (p q : ℕ) (hq_pos : 0 < q) :
  p^2 + 7*p*q + q^2 ≤ (p + 4*q)^2 := by nlinarith

-- Helper: tighter upper bound when p < q

lemma upper_bound_p_lt_q (p q : ℕ) (hp_lt : p < q) (hq_pos : 0 < q) :
  p^2 + 7*p*q + q^2 < (p + 3*q)^2 := by nlinarith

-- Helper: tighter upper bound when q < p

lemma upper_bound_q_lt_p (p q : ℕ) (hq_lt : q < p) (hp_pos : 0 < p) :
  p^2 + 7*p*q + q^2 < (4*p + q)^2 := by nlinarith

-- When p = q, the expression equals (3p)²

lemma square_when_equal (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) :

-- Main classification lemma for forward direction

lemma main_classification (p q : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hq : Nat.Prime q) :
  (∃ m : ℕ, p^2 + 7*p*q + q^2 = m^2) →
    (p = q ∨ (p = 3 ∧ q = 11) ∨ (p = 11 ∧ q = 3)) := by exact?

lemma forward_direction_helper (p q : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hq : Nat.Prime q)

-- Backward direction: each case produces a square

lemma backward_case_eq (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) :

  exact ⟨3 * p, by ring⟩

-- Helper: trichotomy for natural numbers

lemma nat_trichotomy (a b : ℕ) : a < b ∨ a = b ∨ b < a := by
  by_cases h : a < b
  · exact Or.inl h
  · by_cases h' : b < a
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h')
    · have : a = b := by omega
      exact Or.inr (Or.inl this)
